body:
Eligible Hong Kong investors will gain access to a range of private markets strategies, including Asia private assets, infrastructure, and venture & growth, with some offering secondaries exposure.

The jointly developed product gives wealth investors access to ICG's private equity LP secondaries strategy spanning North America and Europe.

The two interval funds give wealth management clients access to private equity, including secondaries and co-investments.

The partnership will also develop products for wealth investors, beginning with an evergreen private equity secondaries fund expected in the coming weeks.

The Vantage Private Equity Secondaries Opportunities Fund makes LP-led and GP-led acquisitions, as well as co-investments, across the Australian and New Zealand private equity market.

Neuberger Private Markets Access Fund, a $2.5 billion tender offer fund targeting small- and mid-cap companies, allocated 17% of its capital to GP-led secondaries as of June.

European and UK wealth managers will be able to access and trade Coller's secondaries funds at scale.

Two CAZ funds are now available through the SoFi Invest platform, covering themes including GP stakes, professional sports, energy infrastructure, space, and defense.

The offering provides a platform for the bank's high-net-worth clients to access Carlyle's global private equity strategies, including secondary investment opportunities.

The structure provides Australian wealth investors with access to Ardian's infrastructure strategies, including secondaries.
